allotment of shares along with;
i). in case of cash allotment a report
from company’s auditor to the effect
that the amount of consideration has
been received in full by the company

resolution authorizing such issue
iii). In case of allotment for

DISCLAIMER
This pamphlet is intended to facilitate the users in enabling them understand statutory responsibilities of a company. The text cited herein is meant to serve merely
as a guideline and is not a substitute to the bare provisions of law. Users are advised to consult the Companies Act, 2017 and subordinate rules and regulations for a
comprehensive understanding of the statutory obligations of the company under these laws.
